test_title: PYST 67: SSC GD Constable - GA & GK (Held On - 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Orunodoi 2.0 is launched by which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Assam__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Orunodoi 2.0 is an enhanced version of the original Orunodoi Scheme launched by the **Government of Assam.**
 
• Orunodoi 2.0 was launched to expand and enhance the original Orunodoi Scheme, which began on **2nd October 2020.**
 
• Orunodoi 2.0, the monthly financial assistance has been increased from the original amount. **Now, 26 lakh women receive Rs. 1,250 per month**.
 
• Social security schemes, such as the** Deen Dayal Divyangan Pension Yojana and Indira Miri Widow Pension**, are also **covered under** **Orunodoi** **2.0**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **State** 
 **Schemes**
 
 

 Rajasthan
 Mukhyamantri Nishulk Annapurna Yojana, Rajasthan Jan Samman Yojana, Mukhyamantri Gramin Bhandaran Yojana, Vishwakarma Shram Samman Yojana, Mukhyamantri Bal Gopal Yojana.
 
 

 Jharkhand
 Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana, Jharkhand Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (JSSY), Birsa Harit Gram Yojana, Phulo Jhano Ashirwad Abhiyan, Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana.
 
 

 Manipur
 Chief Minister Hakshelgi Tengbang (CMHT), Chief Minister-gi Sotharabashing-gi Tengbang (CMST), Disability Pension Scheme, Nipi Keithel Scheme.
 
 

 Assam 
 Chief Minister's Atmanirbhar Assam Abhijan, Arunodoi Scheme, Swanirbhar Nari – Atmanirbhar Assam, Gyan Deepika Scheme, Chief Minister's Sishu Sewa Achoni.
